summary: Lifelong American con man Robert Vernon Spears forged checks and swindled brides before becoming a fake naturopath and abortionist in Texas, then likely bombed National Airlines Flight 967 in 1959 for insurance money.

evidence.note: long opening segment on Benedict Lust and the birth of naturopathy
Lust born 1872 in Germany; TB and the Kneipp water cure
Kneipp's cold-water clinic in Germany where Lust is treated
Spears born June 1894 in Cassville, Missouri, under another name
first headline crime: forged railroad check, caught June 1913
1942 kidnapping, chloroform and shootout with fellow car passengers
buys fake license and diploma, starts Dallas naturopathy practice in 1950
weight-loss pills and radionics devices sold to wealthy suburban women
dangerous abortion pastes; a patient's organs destroyed in 1959
Flight 967 lost November 1959 with Taylor in Spears's seat, 42 dead
caught, convicted of other crimes, dies in prison

notes: Death year 1969 is from outside knowledge; the transcript only says he died in prison a few years after his car-theft term began. Taylor's birth year is unknown. Treated the plane bombing as murder-serial-killers rather than terrorism because it was done for insurance, not politics. DE included for the Kneipp/Lust water-cure segment; it is borderline.
